Registry validation mirrors ClosureEdge and raises on an empty verified_by (FR-018). Not wired into build_run_plan (T012 owns that). Amended 037's existing RC-2 note on natural_classes_dependencies to say it is unconsumed BECAUSE it is unregistered. Producer count adjudicated: the real number is 23, not research.md's 24

Added the 038 report surfaces in report.py: machine-readable block in _to_snapshot_json, human-readable _render_038_lines in render_text_summary, plus _build_from_plan threading the four plan buckets and tallying identity_substitution/enriched/not_reproducible. Empty buckets are OMITTED so a no-038 snapshot stays byte-identical (independently verified by diffing a canonical bare report through main and the branch). Console truncates detail lists at 20 rows and always states the omitted count from the same tuple it sliced; the JSON artifact never truncates. Identity SUBSTITUTION renders as its own section, never folded into ordinary match counts. 34/34 checks pass; tests/unit unchanged 27/2568

Wired build_run_plan to the closure walk: seeds are the plan's actions+overwrites (preserving closure.walk's seed semantics), then walk -> topological -> ClosureEdge materialisation into RunPlan.closure_edges. The FR-018 gate RAISES on any edge with verified False rather than planning from it; also raises on an edge no registry row authorises and on an ambiguous registry (two kinds claiming one category pair). Short-circuits entirely while CLOSURE_EDGES_VERIFIED is empty -- no-op by construction
